$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 66. Declared before the work. WHAT THESE CANNOT EXPRESS: condition 1 is that the workflow pages name the governed repository's own conventions as BINDING. A command_exit can check the words are present; it cannot check an agent reads them, which is what issue 5 measures and what no criterion here can settle. CORRECTION: these invoked the suites directly (python3 conformance/X.py) and read False while passing by hand. The engine exports REPO_GOVERNOR_TARGET into every command_exit target (issue 54), and hooks and onboarding both assert the UNGOVERNED case, so an inherited target makes them correctly fail. Routed through tools/run-conformance.sh, which scrubs those variables. The requirement is unchanged; the invocation was wrong for the environment the engine runs it in.
